description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a dashboard layout in a web application, specifically related to a 'pool' resource within a responsive layout. It sets the page structure, includes partial templates, and supplies content for the dashboard view.

methods.name: $this->layout
methods.description: Sets the main layout template for this view.

methods.name: $this->text
methods.description: Retrieves localized or dynamic text strings by key.

methods.name: $this->section
methods.description: Defines a section in the layout where content will be inserted.

methods.name: $this->insert
methods.description: Includes a partial template or component within the view.

methods.name: $this->supply
methods.description: Provides content to a designated placeholder in the layout.

methods.name: $this->replace
methods.description: Finalizes or closes the current section or template block.
